thread:
noah: Hi all, first-day onboard run failing. Buildkite step errors on docker login (401) and then cache restore times out. I'm using the default hosted agents. Error snippets below.

ci-bot: build #1 started on hosted-agent-11

noah: docker login ghcr.io -u redwood-bot -> 401 Unauthorized

akiko: welcome noah! GH App doesn't grant GHCR package access by default. For onboarding we usually either request a short-lived onboarding machine token or swap to a public base image to avoid pushes.

noah: filed an access request for a short-lived token. added GHCR_TOKEN to pipeline env. login succeeds now but later: "Error: request canceled while waiting for connection" when restoring cache from our S3 bucket.

maya: that's a known transient: hosted-agent S3 egress flakiness. Quick unblocks: 1) set cache restore: false so the build continues, 2) run the step on elastic-us-west, or 3) prefetch artifacts with aws cli using temporary creds.

akiko: also check agent_queue in pipeline header; some new repos pointed to a restricted queue and queue mismatch causes no-agent errors. For onboarding use `agent_queue: onboard-hosted` if you need hosted agents.

infra: INFRA-5023 opened to investigate S3 egress. We'll post updates here when fixed.

noah: I switched to public base and disabled restore; build passed. Thanks all, will update the onboarding README with notes about GHCR token scope and cache flakiness. :thumbsup:
